title: feat(ui): the create-workspace dialog offers a Developer Edition choice where the host serves features.developerEditionCreate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb42UNa6kv5TxxFX8fSVkG7g)_

Fixes #31988

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 「创建组织」对话框在服务端声明 `features.developerEditionCreate: true` 时,多出一个默认不勾选的「Developer Edition」复选框;勾选后用 `?edition=developer` 创建开发者版组织。客户端 `createOrganization` 新增可选 `edition` 参数。
- **为什么改:** 云端开发者版的创建入口(cloud#4042)已上线,但控制台没有入口,只能手工调 API;此卡解锁 cloud#4039。服务端开关已由 #31990 声明并下发。
- **风险与回滚:** 没有开关时对话框与请求逐字节不变;回滚即还原本 PR。拒绝时显示通用错误,绝不自动去掉 edition 重试。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx`(复选框与每次重试携带 edition);`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`(query 拼装);`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`(新键,人数以 count 插值)。
- **两分钟验证:** 在 `ui/` 下运行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/CreateWorkspaceDialog.test.tsx -t "Developer Edition"`,预期 9 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/auth`:** `createOrganization` takes an optional `edition?: 'developer'`. It rides the query of `POST /organization/create` beside `timezone`; the body stays `{ name, slug, logo }`. With no edition and no zone, no query object is sent, so today's request is unchanged. The argument type widens at all four sites (`AuthClient`, the context value, `AuthProvider`, `createAuthClient`). `AuthPublicConfig.features` declares `developerEditionCreate?: boolean`, the key `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` declares since #31990.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`:** `CreateWorkspaceDialog` reads `features.developerEditionCreate` in its existing `getAuthConfig()` effect. On an explicit `true` it draws one unchecked "Developer Edition" checkbox with the hint "Free, non-production, up to 5 members". The checkbox resets on every open. Checked, every create attempt carries `edition: 'developer'`, slug-collision retries included. A refusal shows in the existing error line through `resolveOrgErrorMessage`, with no new mapping row (cloud#1 named no create refusal code). It is never retried without the edition.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`:** `workspace.developerEdition` and the count family `workspace.developerEditionHint` (base key plus every CLDR slot each pack selects) in the 10 hand packs, with zh-Hant regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`. The member cap is interpolated as `count` from one constant in the dialog (`DEVELOPER_EDITION_MEMBER_LIMIT`), as amendment 6755727574 rules.

`SetupPage` is unchanged (ruling 2 of amendment 6754290702).

## Tests

- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/createOrganization-timezone-11908.test.ts`, new `describe`: the real better-auth client, through a stubbed fetch, sends `?edition=developer` only when asked. Edition plus zone puts both on the query, neither in the body. CONTROL: no edition means no `edition` parameter, and the zone-only URL is unchanged.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/CreateWorkspaceDialog.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe` in the existing harness:
  - CONTROL: with the flag absent or `false`, no choice is drawn and the create argument equals today's.
  - With the flag on, the checkbox is unchecked, carries the label and hint, and sends no edition while unchecked.
  - Checked sends `edition: 'developer'`.
  - A slug-collision retry keeps the edition on both attempts.
  - A refusal shows the error, is called once, and the box stays checked.
  - Reopening resets the box.
  - The en and zh-Hans hint slots interpolate `count` and spell no literal 5.

<details><summary>Ablations (src-resolved: both test files import the subject by relative path, so no dist is involved), each restored to HEAD by ablation-replace</summary>

- A1: draw the choice regardless of the flag. 2 CONTROL cases red; restored blob equals HEAD.
- A2: drop `edition` from the client query. 2 client cases red, 5 green; restored.
- A3: never pass the edition from the dialog. The checked, retry and refusal cases red (3), 6 green; restored. A first A3 attempt was refused by the tool before running, because its replacement text already occurred in the file. It was re-run with a distinctive replacement.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `DEVELOPER_ORGANIZATION_MEMBER_LIMIT_REACHED` (sixth member or invitation) reaches `InviteMemberDialog` unmapped and shows the server's sentence. A mapping row is a separate decision; carrier: seat.
- Neither `ui/packages/auth/README.md` nor `content/docs/frontend/**` names `createOrganization` or `CreateWorkspaceDialog` (`git grep`, zero hits), so no docs page changes.
- On a deployment without the door the flag is never served, so the parameter is never sent. That is the CONTROL test, not a runtime fallback.

The first run of these found 12 failures in two i18n pins: the hint family had no base key, and the ru label was English. Both were fixed in `956c7fea`; the two files were re-run at 52/52 green.
- `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`: 71/71 tasks successful.
